subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request and audit-coverage clarification for CloudFinex
messages:
From: Michael Turner <m.turner@cloudfinex.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and audit period clarification

Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — product looked good and the execs want to move quickly. Legal and procurement have one gating item: we need a SOC 2 Type II report covering your 2026 audit period (Jan 1, 2026 - Dec 31, 2026) or a formal coverage letter that explains scope and controls applied to that period.

Two asks from procurement:
- Can you confirm whether you can provide the full Type II report (redacted as needed) by end of week?
- If not, can you provide an auditor-signed coverage letter or interim attestation that confirms control coverage for CloudFinex’s intended data scope?

Procurement also needs a simple index of evidentiary artifacts (what you can share) and an auditor contact for verification. We are aiming to get PO in place by the 27th. Please advise ASAP — this is the last technical gating item.

Thanks,
Michael Turner
Director, Procurement
CloudFinex

[Attachment requested: list of acceptable evidence artifacts (e.g., penetration test, change control logs, access review summary)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@cloudfinex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and audit period clarification

Michael — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can support the PO timing; here’s what I’m proposing to unblock procurement quickly:

1) We will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report for 2026 (redactions for vendor contacts and certain customer identifiers) within 48–72 hours.
2) If procurement insists on auditor-signed language beyond the report, Rishi will work with Greyline (our auditor) to produce a brief coverage letter that confirms the audit period and scope.
3) We’ll publish a single evidence index (CSV) and an S3 bundle with redacted artifacts suitable for vendor review (limited to non-sensitive logs).

Action items for internal team: please see below and reply inline. I’ll push materials to the secure S3 bucket and share a DocuSign link for the PO once procurement confirms.

—Vanessa

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and audit period clarification — auditor coordination

Vanessa — on it. Quick plan from security/legal ops:

- Greyline Audits performed our 2026 Type II. I’ll reach out to their engagement lead (audit@greyline.com) and request an auditor-signed one-page coverage letter that states: audit period, scope (common criteria + CC6 exceptions if any), and confirms that no carve-outs affect CloudFinex’s scope.
- I’ll also prepare an evidence index CSV that lists redacted artifacts we can safely share (change control snapshots, access review summaries, configuration baselines, vendor management attestations).
- For speed, the initial package will be an S3 read-only bundle with a manifest; sensitive items will remain for Auditor-only view under NDA if requested.

Please confirm whether CloudFinex needs the full redacted PDF first or if the coverage letter + index is sufficient for procurement to proceed with PO. If they need the redacted PDF, I’ll mark certain sections for redaction and request Greyline’s concurrence (should add 24 hours).

Rishi

Copying Lauren for legal sign-off on redactions. Marissa
